questions.question: Which international standard governs the determination of static water absorption in leather using the Kubelka apparatus, and what is its fundamental test principle?

answers.a: ISO 12947; measuring mechanical wear breakdown under multi-directional Lissajous friction
answers.b: ISO 2417 (IUP 7); measuring passive capillary liquid uptake and void filling under static immersion without dynamic flexing
answers.c: ISO 5402; evaluating cyclic flex endurance and finish cracking under high bending frequencies
answers.d: ISO 17235; measuring hardness and non-destructive indentation resistance

questions.question: Why does ISO 2419 mandate preconditioning leather test specimens at 20 ± 2°C and 65 ± 2% RH for at least 24 hours prior to initial dry mass (m₁) determination?

answers.a: To dissolve residual salts and extractable vegetable tannins before water exposure
answers.b: To establish thermodynamic moisture sorption equilibrium and eliminate mass discrepancies caused by hygroscopic hysteresis
answers.c: To fully dehydrate the collagen matrix to 0.0% moisture content
answers.d: To thermally sterilize the leather specimen against bacterial decomposition during testing

questions.question: According to ISO 2417, what is the required geometry and dimension of the test specimen cut for the Kubelka apparatus?
In the standard Kubelka apparatus, what is the nominal volume of distilled water charged into lower Bulb A, and to which graduation line must the initial meniscus be adjusted?

answers.a: 50 mL ± 1 mL; adjusted to the 10.0 mL mark
answers.b: 75 mL ± 2 mL; fine-adjusted precisely to the 0.0 mL graduation line on the connecting neck
answers.c: 100 mL ± 5 mL; adjusted to the 25.0 mL graduation line
answers.d: 150 mL ± 5 mL; adjusted to the overflow spout

questions.question: At the macromolecular level, why does vegetable-tanned sole leather typically exhibit a significantly higher static water absorption capacity than chrome-tanned upper leather?

answers.a: Vegetable tannins strip the natural fatty acids, leaving completely hollow structural tubes
answers.b: Vegetable-tanned leather contains abundant hydrophilic polyphenolic hydroxyl groups that hydrogen-bond with water, combined with an open capillary network lacking hydrophobic fatliquors
answers.c: Chromium(III) complexes dissolve readily in water, forming a temporary impermeable precipitate over the grain
answers.d: Vegetable tanning creates non-polar covalent ether networks that repel hydration shells

questions.question: How is the apparent volume (V₀) of a leather test specimen mathematically determined in the ISO 2417 procedure prior to calculating volume absorption (P)?

answers.a: By pycnometric liquid displacement using toluene as the nonswelling immersion liquid
answers.b: From the quotient of initial conditioned mass and apparent density: V₀ = m₁ / ρ
answers.c: By multiplying specimen surface area by micrometer thickness without conditioning
answers.d: By measuring buoyancy force via Archimedes principle in distilled water

questions.question: Why must the Kubelka apparatus be tilted to exactly 90° (horizontal) to initiate the static immersion phase rather than remaining upright or inverted to 180°?

answers.a: A 90° rotation transfers the entire 75 mL of water into Cylinder B to fully submerge the specimen horizontally with minimal trapped air pockets
answers.b: At 90°, the internal chamber pressure drops to a vacuum, driving forced convective penetration
answers.c: At 90°, the graduated scale becomes parallel to gravity to eliminate optical refraction
answers.d: A 90° angle is required solely to keep the analytical balance from destabilizing

questions.question: While 30 minutes is the standard single-point screening duration, which complete series of immersion durations does ISO 2417 designate for full kinetic absorption curves?

answers.b: 15 min, 30 min, 1 h, 2 h, and 24 h
answers.c: 1 h, 6 h, 12 h, 24 h, and 48 h

questions.question: What experimental discrepancy occurs if non-distilled hard tap water containing polyvalent cations (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺) is used in place of distilled water at 20 ± 2°C?

answers.a: Polyvalent ions alter liquid surface tension, bind to ionized collagen carboxyl groups, and alter pore wetting kinetics, producing non-reproducible absorption values
answers.b: Hard water evaporates spontaneously within the sealed glassware during the 30-minute immersion
answers.c: Dissolved calcium causes the borosilicate graduated glass tube to dissolve rapidly
answers.d: Cations induce spontaneous reverse capillary drainage from Cylinder B back into Bulb A during horizontal immersion

questions.question: Why does ISO 2417 require a calibrated circular press punch die cutter rather than cutting the 70 mm test specimen with hand scissors or shears?

answers.a: Hand cutting irregularly crushes and seals peripheral cut fiber pores, causing erratic edge capillary absorption rates
answers.b: Shearing generates electrostatic charges that permanently repel polar water molecules
answers.c: Hand cutting chemically oxidizes vegetable tannins along the sample perimeter
answers.d: Die cutting is used exclusively to reduce specimen thickness
